audit.name: Novu fan-out demo (planned, not run yet)
audit.question: Can one notification be sent to a million subscribers in one go, and what gives way first on the way there?

repos.name: novu
known_gaps: Deployment settings (instance counts, memory limits, queue worker counts) are not in the scoped folders, so sizes are calculated from code only.
The enterprise folders are out of scope; anything that depends on them is not examined.

known_limits: MongoDB rejects any single document larger than 16 MiB
Redis runs commands one at a time on a single thread, so one slow command delays every other client of that instance
MongoDB makes a write to one document atomic; a change spread over several documents is not atomic unless it runs in a transaction
library_assumptions: Job queue: confirm in the Phase 1 map which queue library the worker uses and how it treats a job added again with an id that already exists
HTTP client: confirm whether outgoing provider calls have a request timeout set
out_of_scope: security (anything noticed is withheld and reported privately, see README)
the enterprise folders (enterprise/** and other separately licensed packages)

groups.scope: apps/api/ request handling for triggering a notification, plus the shared use-cases in libs/application-generic/ that it calls
groups.focus: Work done per subscriber inside the request that starts a send; lists of subscribers loaded or looped over in one go.

groups.scope: apps/worker/ and the queue code in libs/application-generic/
groups.focus: Retries, duplicate deliveries, jobs that never finish, and what happens to a large send when a worker restarts.

groups.scope: apps/worker/ and apps/api/ start-up, health checks and shutdown handling
groups.focus: Connection pools, concurrency settings and what a rolling restart does to work in flight.

groups.scope: libs/dal/ repositories, schemas and index definitions
groups.focus: Queries on subscribers, messages and jobs that no index serves; result sets with no limit; documents that grow with the number of subscribers.
